subject: Mid-quarter action: OKR triage, gap-closure plan & dependency asks
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter action: OKR triage, gap-closure plan & dependency asks

Team —

Quick mid-quarter check and a set of concrete asks for QBR prep. I reviewed progress against our four priority OKRs and highlighted the near-term blockers where I need commitments. Summary below; detailed tracker attached (Q2_OKR_gap_tracker.xlsx) and a draft QBR deck in Drive.

Top items (short):
- OKR A — P99 latency: currently down 8% vs. target 20% reduction. Root cause: slow cold-starts on variant v2.
  - Ask: Platform to prioritize INF-342 (autoscaler cold-start fix) for rollout to staging by 07/08 and prod by 07/15. ETA + owner?
- OKR B — Cost per 1M tokens: trending flat, we need batching improvements + a caching experiment.
  - Ask: Research to validate cache policy A/B by 07/05; SRE to reserve two c5g-large nodes for test traffic.
- OKR C — Dedicated EU beta: blocked on security review and procurement terms.
  - Ask: Security (Stephanie) to sign off on the EU private deployment checklist by 07/02; Legal/Procurement to confirm standard terms with Globex procurement by EOD 06/30.
- OKR D — Developer docs & onboarding: still behind; requires 2 BE engineers for SDK refactors.
  - Ask: Maya to propose names and commit 4 sprint-weeks of effort or propose alternative plan.

Please reply with commitments (owner + date) inline. I want this to be short — I will consolidate and present a one-slide triage for the QBR.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q2_OKR_gap_tracker.xlsx, QBR_prep_deck_draft.pdf
